headline.purpose: Card titles, section and page headings. Inter 600 at 24px, tracking -0.025em.

title.purpose: Sub-section headers, dialog titles, list group labels. Inter 600 at 18px.

body.purpose: The workhorse: nearly all UI text. Inter 400 at 14px. Long-form notes step to 16px, capped 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Badges, tags, metadata, micro-labels. Inter 600 at 12px. Buttons use 14px/500.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Default for cards, inputs, containers. Structure comes from a 1px border, not shadow.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Soft navy-tinted lift on hover/focus of an interactive card.

shadows.name: drag
shadows.purpose: Stronger shadow on the floating pill shown while dragging a bookmark.

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: Default ease-out for state transitions and reveals. No bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: duration-hover
motion.purpose: Card action / overlay reveal on group-hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action: save, confirm, apply. Midnight Ink fill, Frost text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:40px; padding:8px 16px; border:none; border-radius:6px; background:#0f172a; color:#f8fafc; font:500 14px/1 Inter, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#1e293b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #0f172a; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action sitting beside a primary. Slate Mist fill, Midnight Ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:40px; padding:8px 16px; border:none; border-radius:6px; background:#f1f5f9; color:#0f172a; font:500 14px/1 Inter, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#e2e8f0; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #0f172a; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Dense, low-chrome action for card toolbars and list rows. No fill at rest; accent tint on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:40px; padding:8px 16px; border:none; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:#0f172a; font:500 14px/1 Inter, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:#f1f5f9; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: The retrieval entry point. 40px field, hairline border, leading magnifier, quiet 1px focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input-search { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:40px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:6px; background:#fff; width:280px; } .ds-input-search svg { color:#64748b; flex:none; } .ds-input-search input { flex:1; min-width:0; border:none; outline:none; background:transparent; font:400 14px/1.4 Inter, sans-serif; color:#020817; } .ds-input-search input::placeholder { color:#64748b; } .ds-input-search:focus-within { border-color:#020817; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #020817; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: The spine of retrieval: a fully-rounded pill, high-contrast, never faint.
components.css: .ds-tag { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:2px 10px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:9999px; background:#0f172a; color:#f8fafc; font:600 12px/1.4 Inter, sans-serif; transition:background .15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tag:hover { background:#1e293b; }

components.name: Bookmark Card
components.description: Signature component. Flat tile at rest; lift + hover-revealed action overlay on approach.
components.html:
Designing for retrieval, not just capture

example.com · 2d ago
components.css: .ds-bookmark { position:relative; display:flex; flex-direction:column; width:240px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:8px; background:#fff; transition:box-shadow .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-bookmark:hover { box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(2,8,23,.08); } .ds-bookmark__img { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:140px; background:#f1f5f9; color:#94a3b8; } .ds-bookmark__body { padding:8px 12px 12px; } .ds-bookmark__title { margin:0 0 6px; font:600 14px/1.3 Inter, sans-serif; color:#020817; display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:2; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; overflow:hidden; } .ds-bookmark__meta { font:400 12px/1 Inter, sans-serif; color:#64748b; } .ds-bookmark__actions { position:absolute; top:8px; right:8px; display:flex; gap:4px; padding:4px; border-radius:6px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.5); backdrop-filter:blur(4px); opacity:0; transition:opacity .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-bookmark:hover .ds-bookmark__actions { opacity:1; } .ds-bookmark__actions button { display:flex; padding:3px; border:none; border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:#0f172a; cursor:pointer; } .ds-bookmark__actions button:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.6); }

narrative.overview: Karakeep is the desk where one person keeps everything worth keeping. Not a corporate dashboard, not a public feed: a private, premium workspace where every saved thing has a place and is fast to reach. The room is dark slate and clean paper; the light falls on the work, not the furniture. Two motions define it: dropping something onto the desk (capture, instant, no ceremony) and reaching back for it later (retrieve, reliable, fast). The system is monochromatic on purpose: navy and a quiet neutral ramp carry the entire interface, so the only saturated color on a normal screen comes from the saved content itself. The chrome recedes; the collection glows.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome navy + neutral chrome; saved content is the only color that matters.
Flat at rest, lifting only when touched.
Tactile, confident components with decisive states.
One typeface (Inter), hierarchy from weight and size.
Dense where density helps retrieval; calm everywhere else.
Full light/dark parity; both themes are first-class.

rules.name: The Content-Is-Color Rule
rules.body: The chrome is navy and neutral, full stop. The only saturated color on an ordinary screen comes from the saved bookmarks themselves: thumbnails, favicons, cover art. Never introduce a decorative accent hue.

rules.name: The Red-Means-Destroy Rule
rules.body: Signal Red appears only on destructive actions and error states. It is never a brand accent, never a highlight, never decorative.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Inter is the only typeface in the product. No second display serif, no accent face, no mono except inside actual code/kbd elements. Distinctiveness is earned through weight, size, and spacing.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and buttons are sentence case or short Title Case, never ALL CAPS body. Uppercase is allowed only on micro-labels of four words or fewer.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces carry no drop shadow at rest. If you see a shadow, the element is being hovered, focused, or dragged. A shadow that's always on is a bug, not a style.

rules.name: The Hover-Reveals Rule
rules.body: Card chrome is invisible until hover. The resting state shows only content; controls appear on approach. This is how a dense wall of bookmarks stays scannable.

dos: Do keep navy + neutral as the entire chrome, and let saved content be the only saturated color on screen.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px border and keep them flat at rest; reserve shadow for hover, focus, and drag.
Do build hierarchy from Inter weight + size alone.
Do hold metadata, captions, and placeholders to at least 4.5:1 contrast; use Slate Quiet / Slate Haze deliberately and bump toward Ink/Frost if a tint pulls them under the bar.
Do keep every animation to color/opacity with an ease-out curve, and give each a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
Do maintain full keyboard operability with a visible focus ring, and keep light/dark at parity.
Do reserve Signal Red for destructive and error states only.
Do hide secondary card actions until hover so dense collections stay scannable.
donts: Don't ship the untouched shadcn / slate starter look. If a screen could be any default shadcn demo, it has no identity yet.
Don't strip a screen to a bare, under-furnished minimal demo. Nice and easy to see, with substance, beats empty.
Don't build a heavy SaaS dashboard: no gradient hero-metric blocks, no endless identical icon-heading-text card grids.
Don't make it a toy: no bouncy/elastic motion, no over-rounded blobs, no emoji-as-UI.
Don't optimize a screen for long-form reading at the expense of save speed or scan/search quality.
Don't use a border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use gradient text, and don't introduce a second decorative accent hue.
Don't apply blur/glass as decoration; the only sanctioned glass is the functional action-overlay scrim over card images.
Don't let any surface carry a permanent drop shadow, and don't use arbitrary z-index values; use the semantic scale.
Don't set sentences in ALL CAPS; reserve uppercase for micro-labels of four words or fewer.
